subject.title: fix(outbound): auto-select single enabled message account

question: Should omitted message-tool account IDs infer the single enabled/configured account after channel selection, while failing closed for zero or multiple enabled accounts?
rationale: The PR changes documented fallback/default behavior for existing multi-account setups, so maintainers need to explicitly accept the compatibility policy before merge.

options.title: Accept shared resolver policy
options.body: Land or replace the PR with a shared resolver that preserves explicit/default/bound account precedence, then infers exactly one enabled configured account and errors clearly otherwise.

options.title: Keep explicit selection required
options.body: Reject or narrow this PR and document that users must set accountId or defaultAccount when the default account is disabled.

options.title: Require channel-owned behavior
options.body: Ask for a WhatsApp/plugin-owned fix if core should not own omitted-account fallback policy across channels.

recommendation.title: Accept shared resolver policy
recommendation.body: Land or replace the PR with a shared resolver that preserves explicit/default/bound account precedence, then infers exactly one enabled configured account and errors clearly otherwise.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored prior direction on the canonical issue and has recent history across the docs/account fallback area.
